acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.attestationOracle_: Initial AttestationOracle address. May be        zero at deploy time and set later via {setAttestationOracle},        but `recordAttestation` reverts until set.
params.factory_: The {IndexFactory} whose clones are authorized to        create intents.
params.initialOwner: Owner permitted to set / rotate the oracle.

createRedemptionIntent(address,uint256,u.details: Phase 3.0: multi-leg. Caller (IndexToken) pre-fills every      leg's `assetId`, `slotIndex`, `originAdapter`,      `dispatchedAmount`, `expectedExit`; every lifecycle bit      (`attested`/`refunded`/`attestedAmount`/`refundedAmount`/      `attestedAt`/`refundedAt`) MUST be zero on entry — the      queue overwrites them as legs resolve.

params.deadline: Unix seconds; the slippage floor on delivered        legs' USDT is waived strictly after this (A-2).
params.legs: Per-leg dispatch record. Caller pre-fills `assetId`,        `slotIndex`, `originAdapter`, `dispatchedAmount`,        `expectedExit`; all lifecycle bits (attested/refunded/        amounts/timestamps) MUST be zero. Reverts on        `IntentQueue_EmptyLegs` if `legs.length == 0`.
params.originator: The burner. Shares are re-minted here on        refunded legs; the consolidated USDT is delivered here on        delivered legs (one unified `finalizeBurn` tx).
params.shares: Burned share amount (FROZEN; consumed by per-leg        snapshot-pure re-mint math).

markRedemptionFinalized(bytes32).details: Unified terminal: handles all-delivered, all-refunded, AND      mixed-outcome resolutions. Releases the R3 lock. The      IndexToken wrapper computes per-leg USDT payout vs share      re-mint from the resolved leg state after this returns.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

recordRedemptionAttestation(bytes32,uint.details: Zero-amount guard mirrors {recordAttestation}: a colluding      signer set could otherwise attest `deliveredAmount = 0` and      force the terminal to under-pay this leg.

params.assetId: Belt-and-suspenders re-check against        `legs[legIndex].assetId` (the typed-data digest already        binds assetId; this catches the oracle being upgraded        with a wrong typehash).

recordRefundAttestation(bytes32,uint256,.details: Verify-the-refund at the LEG granularity: signers PROVE      THORChain returned the native asset for THIS leg (inbound −      outbound fee) to our multisig. Authorizes the refunded-leg      branch of the unified `finalizeBurn` terminal. Zero-amount      guard mirrors the delivery path. Mutually exclusive with      delivery — a single leg cannot be both.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

activeRedemption(address).notice: The PENDING redemption id for `indexToken`, or         `bytes32(0)` if none is in flight (the per-basket R3 lock).

attestationOracle().notice: The single attestation oracle authorized to call         `recordAttestation` / `recordRedemptionAttestation` /         `recordRefundAttestation`.

createMintIntent(address,address,uint256.notice: Creates a new mint intent. Caller MUST be a registered         `IndexToken` clone. Each `slotAssetIds[i]` is the canonical         asset identifier the AttestationOracle will attest against;         each `slotExpectedAmounts[i]` is the adapter's pre-trade         estimate (informational; the attested amount is authoritative         when `IndexToken.finalizeMint` reads back the intent).

createRedemptionIntent(address,uint256,u.notice: Opens a multi-leg redemption (burn → USDT for delivered         legs + share re-mint for refunded legs) intent. Caller         MUST be a registered `IndexToken` clone. Reverts with         {IntentQueue_RedemptionInFlight} if the caller already         has a PENDING redemption — the burn path is serialized         one per basket (global R3 lock; see {RedemptionIntent}).

getIntent(bytes32).notice: Returns the full mint-intent record. Reverts on unknown.

getRedemption(bytes32).notice: Returns the full redemption record. Reverts on unknown.

isFullyAttested(bytes32).notice: True iff every slot in `intentId` has been attested.         Returns false for unknown intents (fail-safe).

isRedemptionFullyResolved(bytes32).notice: True iff every leg of `redemptionId` is attested XOR         refunded. Returns false for unknown.

legResolution(bytes32,uint256).notice: Per-leg resolution probe. Returns `(false, false)` for         unknown redemption / out-of-range leg index.

markCancelled(bytes32).notice: Marks an intent CANCELLED. Caller MUST be the intent's         owning `IndexToken`. Reverts if the deadline has not passed.

markFinalized(bytes32).notice: Marks an intent FINALIZED. Caller MUST be the intent's         owning `IndexToken`. Reverts if any slot is unattested.

markRedemptionFinalized(bytes32).notice: Marks a redemption FINALIZED and releases the per-basket         R3 lock. Caller MUST be the redemption's owning         `IndexToken`. Reverts with {IntentQueue_LegNotFullyResolved}         unless every leg is attested XOR refunded. The unified         terminal handles all-delivered, all-refunded, AND mixed         outcomes — the IndexToken wrapper computes per-leg USDT         payout vs share re-mint from the resolved leg state.

recordAttestation(bytes32,uint256,uint25.notice: Records that a single slot has reached the AttestationOracle's         signature threshold. Caller MUST be the registered oracle.

recordRedemptionAttestation(bytes32,uint.notice: Records a per-leg native-asset→USDT delivery attestation.         Caller MUST be the registered oracle. Reverts on         leg-index out-of-range, assetId mismatch, leg already         attested/refunded, or zero `deliveredAmount`.

recordRefundAttestation(bytes32,uint256,.notice: Records a per-leg refund attestation (THORChain returned         the native asset to our multisig). Caller MUST be the         registered oracle. Reverts on leg-index out-of-range,         assetId mismatch, leg already attested/refunded, or zero         `refundedAmount`.

@dev The single attestation oracle authorized to call
      `recordAttestation` / `recordRedemptionAttestation` /
      `recordRefundAttestation`. Settable by owner so the oracle
      can be rotated without redeploying the queue.
@dev Monotonically increasing counter used to derive intent ids.

@dev Separate monotonic counter for redemption ids. Kept distinct
      from `_intentNonce` so the mint and redemption id spaces never
      share a derivation — defense in depth alongside the separate
      EIP-712 typehashes (Phase 3.0: three structurally-distinct
      typehashes for mint, leg-delivery, leg-refund).

@dev Per-basket R3 global lock: the single PENDING redemption id for
      an `IndexToken`, or zero. Makes the burn-side pro-rata snapshot
      solvent by construction (nothing can reduce a slot balance
      while a redemption is open). Redemption-scope, NOT leg-scope.
      Set on create, cleared by the unified terminal.

@title IntentQueue
 @notice State container for asynchronous mint AND redemption intents
         — see {IIntentQueue}.
 @dev   This contract holds no funds. It is purely a state machine that:
          - records intents created by registered `IndexToken` clones,
          - accepts attestations from a single registered
            `AttestationOracle`,
          - lets the owning `IndexToken` finalize once resolved or
            cancel (mint only) after the deadline. The redemption
            terminal is unified — the all-refunded case is one
            subset of the mixed-outcome `markRedemptionFinalized`.
        No external calls are made from any function here, so there
        is no reentrancy surface. All state changes are CEI-trivial
        (no callbacks). Access control is enforced by `msg.sender`
        checks against the factory and the registered oracle.
